resolved_design_questions.QUESTION: What is the exact authority lease schema (grant, scope, expiry, renewal, revocation)?
resolved_design_questions.RESOLUTION: Resolved by the capability_lease_contract section: canonical fields lease_id, principal, operation, object_ref, expected_revision, mutation_scope, issued_at, expires_at, authority_basis, optional approval_basis, delegation_policy. Lease is operation-scoped, object-bound, principal-bound, exact-revision-bound, short-lived with a bounded max TTL, non-semantic, non-delegable by default. Expiry is a hard denial (now >= expires_at). Consumption is atomic and one-time; reuse/replay is denied; optional revocation is explicit; no implicit renewal, expansion, or substitution. Lease IDs are trusted runtime/private and never model-facing.

resolved_design_questions.QUESTION: Does principal become a typed executor-neutral identity or remain trusted adapter metadata, and how is adapter self-assertion constrained?
resolved_design_questions.RESOLUTION: Resolved: principal becomes a typed executor-neutral semantic identity (principal_model), separate from authority. Five classes are frozen: human, llm_agent_session, executor_adapter, system_mechanical, operator_debug. Principal enters OperationContext only through a trusted injection boundary; the untrusted model cannot self-assert a privileged principal, adapters cannot self-assert, and executor identity is not principal by default. Principal alone grants no mutation authority.

resolved_design_questions.QUESTION: Must the trusted adapter channel (raw resolved paths, trusted roots) be principal-bound / lease-scoped?
resolved_design_questions.RESOLUTION: Resolved: the trusted adapter channel is principal-bound at the trusted runtime boundary before trusted resources enter Core; adapter self-assertion is denied. Trusted resource resolution alone grants no mutation authority. Bounded mutation requires authority evaluation plus a capability lease (CAPABILITY_LEASE_REQUIRED_FOR_BOUNDED_MUTATION=yes). A contract-declared read-only diagnostic operation needs no mutation lease (SAFE_READONLY_LEASE_REQUIRED=no); trusted provenance/identity/resource resolution may still be required for protected resources.

resolved_design_questions.QUESTION: Does approval_required gate authority grants / capability leases?
resolved_design_questions.RESOLUTION: Resolved: approval is a prerequisite at lease issuance, never an authority identity. A boolean/token alone is never unrestricted authority; approval evidence must be bound to the exact operation/object/revision/scope and to a trusted approver/evidence digest before it may enter the bounded authority basis (approval_basis). Approval is not implemented in M3-A2; the descriptor approval_required remains a declared M2 placeholder.

principal_model.definition: Principal is a typed executor-neutral semantic identity: which actor or role acts, expressed without executor-specific vocabulary. Principal is separate from authority: principal identity alone grants no mutation authority.

principal_classes.meaning: operator or human approver acting through a trusted channel
identity_fields: typed principal id (Core/operator-registered, not free-form model input)
principal_classes.trust_evidence: binding evidence supplied by the trusted injection boundary
principal_classes.freshness_channel_binding: time-bounded; bound to the trusted channel it arrived through
principal_classes.notes: Human principals may be approvers; approval remains a lease-issuance prerequisite, not authority identity.

principal_classes.trust_evidence: session binding evidence supplied by the trusted runtime boundary
principal_classes.notes: The untrusted model cannot self-assert a privileged principal; session identity is bound by the trusted runtime, not by the model.

principal_classes.meaning: an adapter/executor acting as an agent (e.g. the hermes adapter channel)
principal_classes.trust_evidence: adapter identity evidence verified at the trusted runtime boundary
principal_classes.notes: Adapters cannot self-assert principal; only the trusted runtime boundary can bind an adapter channel to a principal. Executor identity is not principal by default.

principal_classes.trust_evidence: mechanical provenance evidence from the trusted runtime boundary
principal_classes.notes: Mechanical identity does not imply authority; bounded mutation still requires authority evaluation and lease.

principal_classes.trust_evidence: debug session evidence from the trusted injection boundary
principal_classes.notes: Diagnostic visibility is bounded; even a debug principal cannot bypass authority evaluation or lease rules.

principal_model.trusted_injection_boundary: Principal may enter OperationContext only through the trusted runtime/injection boundary (ingress/trusted adapter channel); it is never accepted from model parameters and never derived from free-form strings. No specific authentication product is chosen by this design; the boundary is defined by mechanism, not vendor.
principal_model.self_assertion_rule: The untrusted model cannot self-assert a privileged principal. Adapters cannot self-assert principal; executor identity is not principal by default; only a trusted runtime boundary can bind an adapter channel to a principal.
principal_model.audit_requirement: The canonical audit record must include the bound principal (design requirement; current audit does not record principal; not implemented in M3-A2).
principal_model.no_authority_by_identity: Principal alone grants no mutation authority; bounded mutation requires authority evaluation and a capability lease.

principal_binding_rule.rule: A principal is bound to a trusted channel at the trusted adapter/runtime boundary before any trusted resource enters Core. The binding is recorded as evidence (typed principal id + channel + freshness). Unbound execution uses the fail-closed default: no privileged principal, no authority. Operator-debug sessions are bound and time-limited.
principal_binding_rule.binding_boundary: trusted adapter/runtime boundary (ingress + trusted adapter channel); never the model-facing input surface
principal_binding_rule.fail_closed: no trusted binding means no privileged principal and no authority; PRINCIPAL_UNTRUSTED otherwise
principal_binding_rule.executor_identity_default: executor identity is not principal by default; only the trusted runtime boundary may bind an adapter channel to a principal

authority_evaluation_model.definition: Deterministic authority evaluation: given a bound principal, an operation contract, a target object reference, an expected revision, a mutation scope, optional approval state, optional semantic decision evidence, the current lifecycle predecessor, and lease validity/current time, the engine computes exactly one stable decision class.

decision_classes.ALLOW: all facts satisfied and no approval prerequisite outstanding; execution proceeds
decision_classes.DENY: a hard constraint is violated; terminal; approval cannot repair it
decision_classes.BLOCKED: a prerequisite/context fact is absent; retryable once state changes
decision_classes.NEEDS_APPROVAL: all mechanical facts satisfied but the approval prerequisite is outstanding

authority_evaluation_model.engine_role: The engine validates facts and constraints only. It never performs semantic reasoning, never chooses subjects, never invents scope, and never expands authority. Semantic decision evidence is supplied by an external semantic/approval boundary and is only checked and bound.
authority_evaluation_model.adapter_boundary: Adapters cannot invent greater authority than Core receives; the authority decision is computed by Core from the frozen inputs; adapters only carry evidence (identity, trusted metadata), never grants.
authority_evaluation_model.lifecycle_predecessor_input: Bounded mutation on a lifecycle subject requires the current lifecycle predecessor as an input fact so the engine can bind to the exact current state; the engine never guesses another lifecycle subject.

capability_lease_contract.definition: A capability lease is the bounded, short-lived, machine-verifiable grant for exactly one bounded mutation. It is trusted runtime/private, never model-facing.

canonical_fields.lease_id: trusted runtime/private identity of the lease; minted at issuance; never model-facing; not authority by possession
canonical_fields.principal: typed principal bound at the trusted injection boundary
canonical_fields.expected_revision: exact expected revision of the target object at consumption
canonical_fields.mutation_scope: bounded mutation scope as declared by the operation contract
canonical_fields.authority_basis: grounds for the grant: principal binding + operation contract hash + optional approval evidence digest
canonical_fields.approval_basis: optional: approval evidence bound to exact operation/object/revision/scope and to a trusted approver/evidence digest
canonical_fields.delegation_policy: non_delegable by default; delegation only via a newly issued bounded lease

lifecycle.issuance: issuance requires: bound principal, authority evaluation ALLOW (or NEEDS_APPROVAL satisfied by bound approval evidence), exact operation/object/revision/scope; a new lease_id is minted
lifecycle.validation: every use validates all canonical fields against the request plus lease validity and current time
lifecycle.expiry: now >= expires_at is a hard denial (LEASE_EXPIRED); LEASE_EXPIRY_ENFORCED=yes
lifecycle.consumption: atomic one-time consumption; the lease is consumed once for exactly the bound mutation
lifecycle.replay: reuse/replay of a consumed lease is denied (LEASE_REPLAY_DENIED)
lifecycle.revocation: optional explicit revocation via a revocation record; revoked leases are denied (LEASE_REVOKED)
lifecycle.renewal: no implicit renewal; a new bounded lease must be issued through issuance
lifecycle.delegation: non-delegable by default; if delegation is ever supported it requires a new bounded lease issued through the same issuance rules

capability_lease_contract.semantic_boundary: A lease never contains semantic planning decisions; no Plan/Work Item/SPEC/Profile Task semantics inside the lease; the lease is mechanical evidence only.
capability_lease_contract.lease_id_policy: Lease ID alone is not authority; the bounded grant is validated by the authority engine at use.
capability_lease_contract.not_implemented: AUTHORITY_IMPLEMENTATION_STARTED=no, LEASE_IMPLEMENTATION_STARTED=no; CAS transaction implementation (exact revision mechanics) is owned by M3-A3+; nothing here is implemented.

approval_relationship.definition: Approval is a prerequisite at lease issuance, never an authority identity. A boolean/token alone is never unrestricted authority.
rules: approval may gate issuance: a contract declaring approval_required cannot receive a lease without bound approval evidence
approval evidence must be bound to the exact operation/object/revision/scope and to a trusted approver/evidence digest before entering the bounded authority basis (approval_basis)
approval is not authority identity: approval evidence never substitutes for principal binding or authority evaluation
approval is not implemented in M3-A2; the descriptor approval_required remains a declared M2 placeholder

trusted_context_model.definition: Trusted context separates four axes: trusted provenance, trusted identity, trusted resource resolution, and authorization. They are independent; none implies mutation authority.
trusted_context_model.logical_reference: A logical resource reference (kind + resource id, e.g. registry_id, pidfile_id, receipt_id) is the model-facing contract input.
trusted_context_model.resolved_path_boundary: The trusted resolver maps the logical reference to a private resolved path; the raw filesystem path is non-model-facing (TRUSTED_ADAPTER_KEYS semantics preserved).
trusted_context_model.principal_binding: A principal is bound at the trusted adapter/runtime boundary before trusted resources enter Core; adapter self-assertion is denied.

axes.meaning: evidence of where a value came from; never authority
typed principal bound at the trusted boundary; identity alone grants nothing
logical ref to private resolved path; resolution alone grants nothing
the only axis that grants bounded mutation, and only through authority evaluation plus a capability lease

trusted_context_authority_rule.rule: TRUSTED_RESOURCE != AUTHORIZED_MUTATION and TRUSTED_ADAPTER != UNBOUNDED_AUTHORITY. Resource resolution alone grants no mutation authority; principal alone grants no mutation authority; bounded mutation requires authority evaluation and a capability lease.

nf2_resolution_contract.NF2_GAP: principal is a free-form self-asserted string with zero enforcement; any library caller can pass any principal while supplying trusted resolved paths; adapters can self-assert principal.
RESOLVED_DESIGN_RULES: principal becomes a typed executor-neutral identity bound at the trusted runtime boundary (OQ-M3A2-02 resolved)
the trusted adapter channel is principal-bound before trusted resources enter Core; adapter self-assertion is denied (OQ-M3A2-03 resolved)
bounded mutation is lease-scoped; contract-declared read-only diagnostic operations need no lease (readonly_authority_boundary)
the canonical audit record must include the bound principal (design requirement)
trusted resource roots become lease-scoped resources only for bounded mutation; resolution alone grants nothing
nf2_resolution_contract.not_implemented: The NF2 gap is frozen as a design contract only; no source change repairs the gap in M3-A2.

readonly_authority_boundary.definition: The read-only diagnostic plane is preserved: contract-declared read-only diagnostic operations (project.resolve, git.inspect, runtime.status, host.status, operations.list) require no mutation lease.
readonly_authority_boundary.safe_diagnosis_no_lease: Safe diagnosis must not require Plan/Work Item/SPEC/Profile Task/approval/followup/mutation lease.
readonly_authority_boundary.protected_resources: Protected resources may still require trusted provenance, trusted identity, and trusted resource resolution even for read-only access.
readonly_authority_boundary.no_escalation: Read-only diagnosis never escalates into mutation; any bounded mutation still requires authority evaluation and a capability lease.

regression_design_proofs.authority_concern: project decision must never act as binding; binding requires a real canonical validated project
regression_design_proofs.frozen_design_invariant: PROJECT_DECISION != PROJECT_BINDING; SUBJECT_BINDING_ZERO_ONE_MANY is 0/1/many fail-closed or NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE; current pointers remain projections; no A1 subject identity resolution
regression_design_proofs.future_implementation_requirement: M3 binding subject plus M4 mechanical binding with revision/CAS enforcement; fake binding before initialization denied

regression_design_proofs.authority_concern: production materialization authority gap: materialization must occur only through the authorized mechanical path
regression_design_proofs.frozen_design_invariant: materialization only through the authorized canonical operation; bounded mutation requires authority evaluation plus a capability lease; authoritative success/failure surfaces in the canonical machine result
regression_design_proofs.future_implementation_requirement: M4 authorized materialization path with SILENT_MATERIALIZATION_FAILURE=denied and AUTHORITATIVE_FAILURE_SURFACING=PASS

regression_design_proofs.authority_concern: silent/non-authoritative materialization failure must never present work as usable
regression_design_proofs.frozen_design_invariant: canonical machine result reflects the authoritative failure; no worker/handoff/ack appears usable while the authoritative materialization failure is hidden; lease consumption is atomic and one-time
regression_design_proofs.future_implementation_requirement: M4 AUTHORITATIVE_FAILURE_SURFACING=PASS with idempotent retry semantics

regression_design_proofs.authority_concern: post-binding recovery must never guess a lifecycle subject or silently ignore missing prerequisites
regression_design_proofs.frozen_design_invariant: deterministic reconciliation or exactly one explicit NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE; silent not_required, blind replay, and guessing another lifecycle subject are denied; the authority engine never chooses subjects or invents scope
regression_design_proofs.future_implementation_requirement: M4 mechanical recovery engine (R_MECHANICAL_RECOVERY); semantic decisions remain outside the engine

regression_design_proofs.authority_concern: distinct lifecycle root causes must never collapse into one error semantics
regression_design_proofs.frozen_design_invariant: PROJECT_BINDING_MISSING, PLAN_MISSING, PLAN_WORKSPACE_CONTEXT_MISSING, ACTIVE_WORK_ITEM_MISSING remain pairwise distinct; A2 adds new design-concept errors (PRINCIPAL_UNTRUSTED, AUTHORITY_DENIED, LEASE_*) without touching the existing registry
regression_design_proofs.future_implementation_requirement: M3/M4 lifecycle producers introduce the distinct errors with their own machinery; taxonomy stays the single declarative error contract

regression_design_proofs.authority_concern: conflicting current_* pointers must never bind the wrong subject
regression_design_proofs.frozen_design_invariant: current projections derive deterministically from durable subject state; ambiguous binding returns NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE; heuristics denied; decision-as-subject semantics deferred to M3-A1
regression_design_proofs.future_implementation_requirement: M3 durable subject graph and subject binding per SUBJECT_BINDING_ZERO_ONE_MANY; legacy pointer state stays migration evidence
